# Autorandr

```nix PereWork/system/autorandr.nix
{ config, pkgs, lib, ... }:
{
  services.autorandr = {
    profiles = let
      common = {
        gamma = "1.099:1.0:0.909";
        # x-prop-non_desktop = 0;
      };
      laptop-base-config = common // {
        mode = "1920x1200";
        rate = "60.00";
      };
      external-base-config = common // {
        mode = "2560x1440";
        rate = "59.95";
      };
      eDP-1 = "";
    in {
      "standalone" = {
        fingerprint = { inherit eDP-1; };
        config = { eDP-1 = laptop-base-config // { position = "0x0"; }; };
      };
      "scrivanie" = {
        fingerprint = {
          DP-3-1-8 = "";
          DP-3-8 = "";
          inherit eDP-1;
        };
        config = {
          DP-3-1-8 = external-base-config // { position = "0x0"; };
          DP-3-8 = external-base-config // { position = "2560x0"; primary = true; };
          eDP-1 = laptop-base-config // { position = "5120x240"; };
        };
      };
    };
  };

  services.xserver.dpi = 96;
}
```
